h14.

**Computation Site:** `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go` — specifically the `ExtractAll()`, `ExtractProperties()`, and `GenerateSnippet()` methods of the markdown Service.

**Triggers:**
1. **CreateMemo** operation (line 108 in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`): `RebuildMemoPayload()` is called on new memo creation
2. **UpdateMemo** operation when content is updated (line 447 in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`): `RebuildMemoPayload()` is called when the "content" path is in the UpdateMask
3. **Batch recomputation** via scheduled runner (`/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`): The `RunOnce()` method rebuilds all memo payloads in batches of 100

**Extracted Properties:** The computation extracts a `MemoPayload_Property` struct containing:
- `HasLink` (boolean) — whether the content contains markdown links
- `HasCode` (boolean) — whether the content contains code blocks or code spans
- `HasTaskList` (boolean) — whether the content contains task list checkboxes
- `HasIncompleteTasks` (boolean) — whether the content contains unchecked task list items
- `Title` (string) — the text content of the first H1 heading if present

Additionally, `ExtractAll()` extracts `Tags` (array of hashtags) and `Mentions` (array of @mentions) which are also stored in the memo payload.

**Snippet Computation:** `getMemoContentSnippet()` (called via `GenerateSnippet()`) produces plain-text preview content truncated to 64 characters, used for memo lists/previews.
